title: Hoffman at MIT studying under Marvin Minsky at the start of AI

tellings.quote: intelligence and you were at MIT like right when you know all of this stuff was starting you were studying under Marvin Minsky which is amazing and

plain: The guest, a scientist named Hoffman, was at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology right when the field of artificial intelligence was starting, and studied under Marvin Minsky, one of its pioneers. Michels says this to his guest at the start of their talk, calling it amazing and also naming the linguist Noam Chomsky. He brings it up because it gives Hoffman's ideas about the mind and intelligence a starting point at the very birth of the field.
